newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian OLOs end firmer before data-packed holiday.
newsitem.headline: Belgian OLOs end firmer before data-packed holiday.

text.p: Belgian OLOs ended firmer on Wednesday after recovering from afternoon selling in the wake of stronger-than-expected U.S. first quarter real GDP data.

"Before the figures the yield curve flattened, then it steepened afterwards," one dealer said, noting buying of 10-year paper on the dips. The March 2007 benchmark BE286= yielded 5.93 percent at the close, down from 5.96 percent on Tuesday.
Market makers had now mostly squared their books, with U.S. NAPM, personal income and spending data and weekly jobless claims all due during Thursday's May Day market holiday here US-ECI.

On Friday those who choose not to extend their holiday into a long weekend will brace themselves for important monthly U.S. jobs data. April non-farm jobs are forecast to come out at 211,000, up from March's 175,000.
Dealers said Wednesday's trading was largely technically driven. June OLO futures closed 14 basis points higher at 120.71, around the middle of the day's 36-basis-point range.
